gloss: one-shot story; complete story; stand-alone work

definitions.gloss: one-shot story; complete story; stand-alone work
definitions.explanation: a self-contained story that is complete in one installment, not serialized; commonly used for manga one-shots published in magazines

examples.japanese: {今週号|こんしゅうごう}には{読|よ}み{切|き}りマンガが{掲載|けいさい}されている。
examples.english: This week's issue features a one-shot manga.

examples.japanese: {読|よ}み{切|き}りから{連載|れんさい}になった{作品|さくひん}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many works started as one-shots before becoming serialized.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{読|よ}み{切|き}りなので、{一晩|ひとばん}で{読|よ}める。
examples.english: This novel is a standalone work, so you can finish it in one night.

notes:
FORMATION:
{読|よ}む (to read) + {切|き}る (to finish completely) → something that can be read to completion in one sitting

MANGA CONTEXT:
In manga publishing, {読|よ}み{切|き}り refers to:
- A self-contained story (not serialized)
- Often used to test new concepts or artists
- May lead to serialization ({連載|れんさい}) if popular
- Published in manga magazines alongside serial chapters

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- マンガの{読|よ}み{切|き}り (one-shot manga)
- {短編小説|たんぺんしょうせつ}の{読|よ}み{切|き}り (complete short story)
- {読|よ}み{切|き}り{作品|さくひん} (stand-alone work)

CONTRAST WITH:
- {連載|れんさい} (serialization - ongoing story in installments)
- {長編|ちょうへん} (long-form work)

PUBLISHING PATH:
{読|よ}み{切|き}り → (if successful) → {連載|れんさい} → (if successful) → {単行本|たんこうぼん} (collected volume)

RELATED:
- {連載|れんさい} (serialization - antonym)
- {短編|たんぺん} (short story)
- {完結|かんけつ} (completion)
- ワンショット (one-shot - English loanword)
